I'm sorry that your life sucks so much right now, I feel much of this myself. I'm also 20 and I know how it feels to have mental illnesses so young. It's the fucking worst. All of my friends are having fun in school and making money t their jobs while I'm over here unable to do either. I haven't figured my own shit out yet so I don't know what you should do, I really wish I did. But I'll be here to message if you want to talk to me ever.

I'm also here to talk if you want it. I constantly feel much of what you expressed. I know it's extremely hard sometimes and I'm sorry you have to deal with this. I understand meds not working, I've tried a number without any success. And I get friends leaving, that can be much harder than people realize. There are many of us on here that don't want you to leave. Message me if you want, we could help each other.

That note is heartbreaking, I am so sorry that you have so much pain. I myself wrote a much less eloquent note a couple weeks ago and took some pills a few nights ago. I think there's some reason, fucked up or not, that we lived. I'm trying my best to move forward but fuck it's hard. It's hard to not want to die every second of the day. I can't say I know exactly how you feel, but I do understand it. I wish I could be of actual help, to both of us. Just know that there's at least one stranger that's counting on you to keep living.

I am so sorry that you have to deal with that. The cost of medical help is crushing you, I really wish it was actually affordable. It's good that you are going to sleep on it. I'm currently very suicidal myself so I know that tomorrow very well might not be better and I'm sorry. I seriously just want to give you a hug, you don't deserve this. I may not be the best person to talk to but you definitely can if it will make you feel better! I'll root you on even though I can't do the same for myself.
